summary: The registrant AngloGold Ashanti plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on 5 May 2026. All resolutions were passed as ordinary resolutions, including receipt of annual accounts, approval of remuneration report, election/re-election of directors, reappointment of auditors, and authorization of political donations up to £100,000. No special situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine report of shareholder meeting outcomes, thus does not constitute a special situation.
